I can't even say the service is bad because it's nonexistent. I don't recommend this pet store and I'll recount my experience that happened between yesterday and today.
Yesterday I called wanting SPECIFICALLY to have my cat tested for FeLV and then vaccinate her against it, and I explained the whole situation. Even so, the attendant, Rose, didn't understand anything I was saying, and I had to be redundant for her to grasp the information. The appointment was scheduled for today, and anyone who has cats knows the stress that the animals go through when they have to leave home, especially my cat, as she gets very scared and stressed, crying all the time. Upon arrival, today's receptionist also couldn't explain anything and sent me straight to the veterinarian's room. Okay, upon arrival, the veterinarian tells me that NOT ONLY WERE THE TESTS FINISHED and they didn't tell me on the phone!!! but they also marked my cat in the system as if she were a dog and put that the supposed "dog" would take a test that has nothing to do with it. So I got up and left immediately because they made a fool of me and subjected my cat to UNNECESSARY stress resulting from the incompetence of their own employees! I absolutely do not recommend them to ANYONE.
The employee doesn't know what grooming is.
